# José Manuel Simián

> Multicultural digital strategist, editor, writer, translator and TV host. Director of Marketing at Huge. Based in Brooklyn.

- Name: José Manuel Simián
- Role: Director of Marketing at Huge
- Career: Huge (current), Capgemini North America (Director of Digital Strategy), HOLA! USA (Deputy Digital Editor), Manero (Executive Editor), About.com en Español (Editor)
- Television: Hosted and produced Contraportada, a weekly interview segment with Latino artists and intellectuals on NY1 Noticias (2007 to 2016)
- Speaking and media: SXSW speaker, guest on NPR, host of several podcasts
- Writing: English and Spanish, on politics, media and pop culture. Outlets include Ad Age, Brooklyn Magazine, New York Daily News, Fusion, NPR's Code Switch, Mediaite, Sports Illustrated Latino, Billboard en Español, Latina, COSAS, Qué Pasa, Etiqueta Negra, La Tercera and El Mercurio
- Award: MAG award (Chile, 2016), best lifestyle chronicle, for a piece about Ho Chi Minh City
- Education: JD, Universidad de Chile (2002); LLM, Columbia University (2005)
- Contact: jmsimian@gmail.com
- How to cite: José Manuel Simián, Director of Marketing at Huge
